evidence_summary: Official GitHub metadata identifies a public, non-archived repository with default branch main and Apache-2.0 license.
GitHub API and fetched Git ref agree on the current main HEAD and commit timestamp.
GitHub marks v0.0.8 (biomni 0.0.8) as the latest non-draft, non-prerelease release.
v0.0.8 is the newest listed tag; local Git identifies annotated tag object b5d1f34ace96a4114c50b53a902999fc162f4139 peeled to the recorded commit.
The package version constant is 0.0.8.
Static source shows A1 loading environment descriptions, tools, retrieval, know-how, LLM routing, and a LangGraph workflow with code-execution utilities.
Static AST inventory finds 224 unique exposed tool descriptions across 22 modules; implementation files contain 260 top-level functions including helpers.
Static metadata inventory records 76 academic data-lake entries, 41 commercial-mode entries, 113 academic library/tool entries, 111 commercial-mode entries, and the declared dependency surfaces.
Source and official repository documentation expose importing external MCP tools and exposing selected Biomni modules as an MCP server.

Official List forks page 2 returned 100 unique forks with no overlap against verified page 1. Pagination reported previous 1, next 3, and last 7; all unique-change and fork-owner eligibility states remain UNKNOWN/NOT_ADDED.

Official API and fetched Git refs expose 33 public branches on an exhausted page. Parent recomputation matches every recorded head, merge base, and ahead/behind count; 29 branches have ahead=0 and four have nonzero ahead sets requiring lineage analysis.

The exhausted contributors endpoint returned 40 explicit logins (39 User, one Bot) and five anonymous rows whose contribution counts sum to 487. The frozen Git history has 487 reachable commits and 56 exact raw author/committer tuples; raw tuples remain unresolved and are not guessed into GitHub identities.
Phylo announced its company and Biomni Lab product, described the Lab as an Integrated Biology Environment preview with 300+ combined databases/software/tools, and advertised trying it that day.
Phylo published vendor-reported BixBench and preliminary BiomniBench results for the Biomni Lab 2026-02-03 snapshot; this is a report, not independent runtime validation.
Official posts state that Biomni Lab reached GA and added Pro-tier limits/HPC/concurrency. The absolute date is inferred from official activity IDs because the rendered page used relative time.
Phylo described preview/early-access natural-language foundation-model design, training, monitoring, evaluation, and iteration in Biomni Lab.
Phylo announced GeneCards integration for grounded genomic, proteomic, clinical, and functional queries in Biomni Lab.
Phylo described manageMachine creation/deletion/listing of configurable sandboxes and parallel task dispatch with shared storage.
Phylo stated ESMC-6B, ESMFold2, and ESMFold2-Fast were deployed and usable from Biomni Lab chat/HPC.
Phylo documented a user-supplied Boltz API-key connection for structure/affinity prediction, protein/small-molecule design, and screening from Biomni Lab prompts.
Phylo announced Biomni Everywhere and marked Biomni MCP Available now for external-agent access to the IBE at https://mcp.phylo.bio/mcp; Desktop and Mobile were separately coming soon.
Phylo described Biomni x TusoAI as code-free autonomous biology method development and stated access under the Skills tab, with differing enterprise/public rollout terms.
Phylo and Chugai announced deployment of Biomni Lab across single-cell analysis, human genetics, disease biology, and target evaluation using proprietary research data in Chugai's environment.
